definitionZh: 内置式的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内置式的端套,根据元素的写法模式,方向性和文本方向,将元素映射到物理偏移. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.
sourceDefinition: The inset-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end inset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
